Hi Sally — thanks, congrats on the signing.

Quick note on timing: I'll confirm the precise endorsement language with Legal (Aditya) and Ops (Laura) this morning. Our standard ask is to be named as "Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors, and employees" as additional insured on the General Liability policy, with waiver of subrogation on the Workers' Comp where allowed. Minimum limits we typically require: GL $1M per occurrence / $2M aggregate; Auto $1M; E&O/Professional Liability $2M.

That said, if the broker can draft a COI now and put a broker hold on issuance until we confirm endorsement wording, that will buy us the time to review and avoid multiple re-issues. Hannah — thanks for the heads up. A few clarifications from Legal:

- Additional Insured: Redwood requests the following endorsement naming language (preferred): "Redwood Inference, Inc., its subsidiaries, affiliates, officers, directors, and employees are hereby named as Additional Insured as respects liability arising out of the operations of the named insured under the Contract."
- Policy types & limits we need confirmed on the COI: Commercial General Liability (1M/2M), Auto Liability (1M), Employers' Liability (500k), Professional Liability / E&O (2M). If the broker cannot show E&O on the COI, provide carrier contact and policy number for verification.
- Waiver of Subrogation: desirable for Workers' Comp where state law permits — include if available.
- Primary and Non-Contributory endorsement preferred where carriers allow.
- Endorsement document: please attach the endorsement pdf (carrier form) if available. A scanned "endorsement" line on the COI is not sufficient for some procurement teams; they sometimes need the carrier-issued endorsement.

Given BrightOps's timeline, if the broker can provide a COI with the above language on a broker hold, Ops can accept provisional evidence and we will record a follow-up to secure carrier endorsement within 30 days.

Laura — can Ops accept a broker-hold COI provisionally for invoicing, or do we need full carrier endorsement before payment?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
